zh.question: 直播进行到此刻，主播刚在地区总决赛拿下第一名，与连麦搭档小薇互相致谢后，双方道别，主播说“那我先走了拜拜”结束连麦。接下来主播最可能做什么？

zh.question: 在这场多人PK的最后阶段，画面中主播正密集感谢观众送来的宝箱礼物，并反复号召大家'抽暴击卡''加成'，准备做最后冲刺。此时PK计时已进入最后一分钟，主播提到对方刚打出一张迷雾卡、自己这边暂时还领先、'最后一定要守塔'。在主播喊出'321暴击卡来'之后的紧接着的时刻，接下来最先发生的变化是什么？
options: A. 对方突然大量抽卡、卡牌大师登场，分数迅速反超，迫使己方紧急把借力暴击全部倾泻出去守塔
B. 己方率先响应主播'321暴击卡来''最后一定要用暴击加借力'的号召主动打出暴击加借力组合，先稳住并扩大领先优势
C. 双方陷入抽卡僵持，己方暂时领先的优势一直维持到PK结束
D. 主播宣布放弃守塔，提前结束PK、转入连麦才艺惩罚环节

en.question: This is the final stage of a multi-player PK battle. In the video, the host is intensively thanking the audience for sending treasure chest gifts and repeatedly calling on everyone to "draw critical strike cards" (抽暴击卡) and "apply buffs" (加成) to prepare for the final sprint. At this moment, the PK timer has entered the last minute. The host mentions that the opponent has just played a fog card (迷雾卡), that their side is temporarily leading, and that "we must defend the tower at the end" (最后一定要守塔). Immediately after the host shouts "3, 2, 1, critical strike cards, come on" (321暴击卡来), what is the very next change to occur?
options: A. The opponent suddenly draws a large number of cards, the Card Master (卡牌大师) appears, and their score quickly overtakes, forcing our side to urgently dump all leverage critical strikes (借力暴击) to defend the tower

B. Our side takes the initiative to respond to the host's call of "3, 2, 1, critical strike cards, come on" and "we must use critical strikes plus leverage at the end" by playing a critical strike and leverage combination first, stabilizing and expanding our leading advantage
C. Both sides fall into a card-drawing stalemate, and our side's temporary leading advantage is maintained until the end of the PK
D. The host announces they are giving up on defending the tower, ending the PK early, and transitioning to the connected-mic talent punishment segment (连麦才艺惩罚)

zh.question: 在这场多人PK刚进入游戏的开场阶段，关于对方（对面）的暴击出卡情况，实际观察到的是？

B. 对方开场只是在不断上暴击卡做准备、似在持续暴击而实为积攒，尚未实际打出暴击压制
C. 对方开场完全没出暴击卡、全程囤卡观望
D. 对方开场就把暴击卡一次性全部打完、之后再无暴击可用

en.question: During the opening phase of this multi-player PK just as the game starts, what was actually observed regarding the opponent's critical strike card (暴击卡) play?

B. The opponent was merely putting up critical strike cards to prepare at the start, appearing to constantly land critical strikes but actually accumulating them, and had not yet unleashed actual critical strike pressure
C. The opponent did not play any critical strike cards at all at the start, hoarding cards and waiting to see throughout
D. The opponent played all of their critical strike cards at once at the start, and had no more critical strikes available afterwards

Both are introduced by the voiceover with general compliments and have not been named yet. At the same time, in the live stream bullet comments (弹幕), fan groups of multiple streamers are supporting their respective streamers simultaneously. The screen-swiping content is roughly divided into four groups: 'With starlight as a gift and the red carpet as the prelude, Sun Ensheng has a promising future' (星光为礼，红毯为序，孙恩盛未来可期), 'May the Gen Gate last forever' (哏门永存), 'Accompanying through green hills without complaint' (不辞青山相伴与控), 'The journey of Tingchao Pavilion begins' (听潮阁征程启); 'Lin Siqi, I've started looking for you' (林思琪我开始找你了); 'Walking with the light, Ying is here for you' (沐光同行，莹你而在); and 'Pipi Zhu shines in Sanya' (皮皮朱璀璨三亚). B. Pipi Zhu (皮皮朱) — The bullet comments supporting 'Pipi Zhu shines in Sanya' continue to swipe the screen during this segment, with a momentum second only to Sun Ensheng's group. As the grand finale of Tingchao Pavilion, Sun Ensheng's individual appearance might be deliberately arranged for a later climax segment. The one immediately following the current two general-compliment runway walkers could be Pipi Zhu, who is also actively building momentum but has not yet appeared individually.
C. Lin Siqi (林思琪)
D. Mu Yingying (沐莹莹)
